sheets.name: Dialogue
sheets.comment: contains all information about a Dialogue System conversation used in the game. additional triggering and non-identifying information is handled by mapped metas

fields.name: has_player_initiated_question
fields.comment: this should be true for gossips and dynamic questions

opaqueFields.name: completion_arc
opaqueFields.comment: this allows specifying a custom completion arc, otherwise the last primary arc is assumed

opaqueFields.name: priority
opaqueFields.comment: priority is shared across all eligible dialogue unless the dialogue category itself implies priority (eg final idle is always lower than quest, and gossip cannot appear outside of the gossip menu)

scope: Selected registry identity, exact primary/initial actor relations and arc question flag only; other fields remain opaque
